title: CE42006: Behaviour Of Rc Structures
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

R.C. Structures: Material-load environment and time dependent responses.
Problems relating to non-uniform drying shrinkage and creep under varying
stress. Behaviour of concrete under multi-axial stress, failure theoriesplasticity, Damage in RC structures, interaction with reinforcement. General
principles and philosophies of design with special references to the codal
provisions. Serviceability and stability requirements. Yield line and strip
methods of design of slabs
